description:
PearOffice is spreadsheets, documents and slides you share with a link and edit together, straight between your devices. No account, no subscription and no company holding a copy of your files.

SPREADSHEETS, DOCUMENTS AND SLIDES

- Spreadsheets with around 400 formulas, charts, filters, comments, cell formats and colour rules
- Documents with headings, lists, tables, pictures and links
- Slides with layouts, shapes, pictures, charts and themes, and a presenter view
- Open and save Excel, Word and PowerPoint files, plus CSV, Markdown and PDF

EDIT TOGETHER, LIVE

Send someone an invite link. Each link works once and lasts 24 hours, and you choose whether they can edit or only view. Everyone in a file sees each other's changes as they happen, and who is working where. The owner can remove someone at any time, and they see nothing new after that.

NO ACCOUNT, NO SERVER

Your files live on your devices and the devices of the people you share them with, and sync directly between them, encrypted. There is nothing to sign up for. Your identity is a key made on your phone, and a 12-word recovery phrase brings it back on a new device.

USE ALL YOUR DEVICES

Link your iPhone, iPad and Mac once and they keep the same files.

AN OPTIONAL SEEDER

Files sync while the people in them are online. A seeder is a device you leave running, such as a home server or your own computer, that keeps an encrypted copy so everyone catches up even when nobody else is online. It cannot read your files.

WHEN A DIRECT CONNECTION IS NOT POSSIBLE

Some networks block direct connections between devices. PearOffice can then fall back to a relay run by PeerLoom, which passes on encrypted data it cannot read and keeps nothing. You can turn this off in Settings.

PearOffice has no ads, no tracking and no analytics, and is MIT licensed.

whatsNew:
What's Changed

New Features

  - Coloured dropdowns. A dropdown list in a sheet can show each choice as a coloured pill, as in Google Sheets. Choose Dropdown from a cell's menu and the values already in those cells become the choices, each with its own colour. Tap a choice in the setup to change its colour
  - More than one choice. Turn on "Allow more than one choice" and tick as many items as you like. Each one shows as its own pill
  - Smart chips. Type @ in a cell to add a date, a person from the file or one of your files or folders. People show with their picture and current name and files   with their icon. Dates get a calendar button for changing them
  - Links to your files and folders. Link a cell to another PearOffice file or one of your folders from the Link button's Go to list. Anyone the file is shared with can open it; others are told they don't have it
  - Copy link. Every file and folder on the start screen has Copy link in its menu. Paste it into a chat or email, and opening it takes you straight there

Improvements

  - The dropdown list ticks the current choice and has Edit choices at the bottom
  - Excel and LibreOffice files keep the colours of single-choice dropdowns, and PDFs show the pills
